input.quote: 15.4 Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement, neither Party makes any representation or extends any warranties of any kind either express or implied, including, but not limited to, warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, noninfringement or validity of any patents issued or pending
input.rationale: Article XV contains only Effective-Date representations from Array as to IP ownership, absence of conflicting grants, litigation and regulatory/legal compliance (p0691–p0703); nothing warrants the conformity or quality of the Materials Array supplies under Article IX, and no remedy (replacement, repair or refund) is provided anywhere. Article IX merely defers specifications and "customary terms" to future clinical and commercial supply agreements (p0501, p0510), which leaves Ono with no conformance warranty under this Agreement. Combined with the broad implied-warranty disclaimer in 15.4 (which does carve out express terms, so it does not swallow anything, but there is nothing left to carve out), the deal falls below even the fallback position of a conformance warranty with a real remedy. We therefore propose a new Section 9.7 warranting that Materials conform to specifications and were Manufactured in accordance with GMP and applicable Law, with replacement or refund at Ono's election.

ops.text: 9.7 Materials Warranty. Array warrants that all Materials supplied by or on behalf of Array to Ono under this Agreement will, at the time of delivery and through the expiration of the applicable shelf life or retest date, (a) conform in all material respects to the applicable product specifications and the certificate of analysis for the relevant batch, and (b) have been Manufactured in accordance with GMP and all other applicable Law. Array further warrants that it shall perform its obligations under this Agreement in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards. For any Materials that fail to conform to the foregoing warranty, Array shall, at Ono's election, promptly replace such Materials at no additional cost to Ono or refund the amounts paid by Ono for such Materials, in each case together with any shipping, handling and destruction costs incurred by Ono.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Array supplies Drug Substance and Drug Product but gives no conformance warranty or remedy, so we added a specifications/GMP warranty for Materials with replacement or refund, consistent with our playbook position that the supplier stands behind its work. We can accept a shorter warranty window tied to shelf life if that better matches Array's upstream supply terms.
proposal.summary: Insert a Materials conformance/GMP warranty with replace-or-refund remedy as new Section 9.7.
